fusions.name: Torn-Out Harpoon
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. You wrench an old harpoon from your hide and drive it in, dealing 9 damage and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Keel
fusions.desc: Sends a cone of cold deep water ahead of you, dealing 28 damage to everything caught in it, ignoring resistances. Each hit has a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unyielding Hide
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.
